react-video-kit/ads/vast#vast.name: vast
react-video-kit/ads/vast#vast.doc: Plays a VAST tag's linear pre-roll with no SDK, in a second video element over the content. That needs no third-party script, but it does no viewability or verification measurement, so use `ima()` for ad networks that require them.

members.name: tag
members.doc: The VAST tag's URL.

members.name: maxRedirects
members.doc: How many wrapper redirects to follow.

react-video-kit/ads/ima#ima.name: ima
react-video-kit/ads/ima#ima.doc: Google's Interactive Media Ads SDK, which AdSense and Ad Manager require. It loads with the source, because it must be ready by the first play's gesture, and it draws its own countdown and skip button. If an ad blocker stops it, the content plays.

members.name: tag
members.doc: The ad tag's URL.

members.name: sdkUrl
members.doc: Where to load the IMA SDK from.
